name: Mosharrof
purpose: A modular AI ecosystem where each meaningful component is an independent entity with a bounded brain, memory, tools, permissions, policy, communication and audit trail.

architecture.capability_formula: AI_BRAIN x PERMISSION x POLICY x SCOPE x IDENTITY
architecture.core_role: coordinate, govern, register and communicate; do not collapse all entities into one brain
architecture.model_strategy: model-agnostic adapters so models can be upgraded without replacing entity identity, memory or policy
architecture.organization: one responsibility per entity; one canonical folder per domain; machine-readable registries are authoritative

non_negotiable_rules: DELETE and destructive operations are permanently denied
child entities receive only permissions required for their responsibility
all capability-changing actions must pass policy checks
important state and decisions must be auditable
new entities must be registered before activation
existing tools and projects remain isolated until explicitly connected
